summary: Salesman who married Ann Jason in 1941 and died at Scranton in 1975; John's great-granduncle.
bio: Anthony Gaetano Petrillo, known as Tony, was born on 26 November 1907, a son of John and Maria Antonia Petrillo. His second name was apparently given in honour of his great-grandfather Gaetano di Marino. He worked as a salesman and in 1941 married Ann Jason, by which time both his parents had died. He died in February 1975 at Scranton, Lackawanna County, Pennsylvania.
